name: kms:PutKeyPolicy with a NotResource-only carve-out (broad non-read) must warn WILDCARD-RESOURCE at HIGH
note: S3-rules-breadth (B) regression, syntax-keyed-severity fail-open. A NotResource-only grant reaches every resource EXCEPT the listed few - here every KMS key except one nonexistent ARN - which is as account-wide as Resource:*. The old severity keyed on stmt.resources.some(isBroadArnResource); stmt.resources is EMPTY for a NotResource grant, so broadArn was false and WILDCARD-RESOURCE scored 'medium', slipping under the default 'high' gate: CLI exit 0 CLEAN on 'put a key policy on every key except one'. Effective breadth, not syntax: a NotResource-only broad non-read Allow is inherently broad -> HIGH. Contrast Resource:'*' on the same action, already HIGH.
